#### DE between SALL1 OE and wt

```{r wilcoxauc DE SALL to ctrl per cluster, min cell number}

protein_coding <- scan('/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/nazbukina/General/protein-coding_gene.txt', character(), quote = "")
seurat_clean_prot <- subset(seurat_clean, features=as.vector(protein_coding))
DefaultAssay(object = seurat_clean_prot) <- "RNA"
seurat_clean_prot <- DietSeurat(seurat_clean_prot, counts=T, data=T, assays='RNA')
seurat_clean_prot@meta.data$barcode <- seurat_clean_prot@assays[["RNA"]]@data@Dimnames[[2]]
ClusterList <- SplitObject(seurat_clean_prot, split.by = 'celltype')


presto_fun<-function(condition, seurat_array){
  wilcoxauc(seurat_array, group_by='condition', groups_use=c(condition, 'control'))
}


deg_info <- purrr::map_dfr(ClusterList, function(x){
    
    x <- NormalizeData(x)
    
    cond_list<-c("control", "OE")
    nsample = min(table(x@meta.data[["condition"]])) #sample to minimum
    set.seed(1)
    bigsampled<-c()
    samplingdf=as.data.frame(x@meta.data[['condition']], x@assays[["RNA"]]@data@Dimnames[[2]])
    colnames(samplingdf) = c('condition')
    samplingdf['barcode'] <- rownames(samplingdf)
    
    for (treatment in cond_list){
      #print(organoid)
      tosample = samplingdf[samplingdf$condition==treatment,]
      sampled <- sample(tosample$barcode, nsample)
      bigsampled<- c(bigsampled, sampled)
      
   
}
    x<-subset(x, subset = barcode %in% bigsampled )

    out <- do.call("rbind", lapply(c("OE"), presto_fun,seurat_array=x))
    out$cell_type = rep(unique(x$celltype), dim(out)[1])
    out$ncells<-rep(nsample, dim(out)[1])
    out
})

deg_info <- deg_info %>%
  filter(group == "OE") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.1) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Enriched",
                           logFC < -log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Depleted",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged"))
deg_info

```
